policy: Append-only. Never edit or delete an entry. Each entry commits to the previous entry's sha256 (prev_entry_sha256 -> entry_sha256), so any retrospective edit is detectable by `verify`. One file per UTC day; a day's file is never rewritten after it is closed. Chain truth is re-derivable via `audit`.
